step7.title: Custom Confirmation Message
step7.description: Create a personalized message that customers receive after booking your service. This is optional - if not provided, a standard confirmation will be sent.
step7.infoBody: This message is automatically sent to customers immediately after they complete their booking and payment. It should include next steps, contact information, and any preparation instructions.
step7.messagePlaceholder:
Enter your custom confirmation message here...

Example:
Thank you for booking our service! We're excited to work with you.

What happens next:
• We'll call you within 24 hours to confirm details
• Our team will arrive on time and ready to work
• All work comes with our quality guarantee

Questions? Feel free to contact us at [your contact info].

Best regards,
[Your Company Name]
step7.gettingLong: Getting long - consider keeping it concise
step7.tipsTitle: Tips for a great confirmation message:
step7.tip1: Start with a warm thank you and confirmation
step7.tip2: Explain what happens next and when
step7.tip3: Include your contact information for questions
step7.tip4: Add any preparation instructions or reminders
step7.tip6: Use emojis sparingly for a modern touch
